text:
Sam (PM): Quick sync: Fern requested per-tenant opt-in for fastfail_v2 plus regional staging and a strict fallback flow. Need a rollout sketch today.
Jordana (ENG): Proposal: flag scoping levels: global > region > tenant. Default off. Tenant opt-in requires Dedicated plan. Rough time: flag API + scope support ~10 business days.
Kevin (SRE): Ops note: per-tenant spikes could cascade. We must gate with token quotas and a circuit breaker. Suggested rollout windows: 1% global canary -> 5% region -> 20% region with soak and alarms.
Tara (RESEARCH): For A/B test: define cohorts and compute sample sizes. Primary metric: P95 latency; secondary: hallucination/regression rate. Recommend min 7-day soak per cohort for stable signals.
Sam (PM): Customer asked for auto-fallback to a quantized model on surge. Can routing switch automatically based on SLO triggers?
Jordana (ENG): Yes. We can add routing policy triggers: if p95_latency > TH or queue_depth > N then route to model_variant quant-4. Add boolean flag fallback_on_surge per-tenant.
Kevin (SRE): Ops runbook (draft): immediate kill = flip tenant flag off + emergency fallback. If auto-fallback misfires, run deploy-bot rollback. Need one-click kill-switch in Console and rate throttles.
deploy-bot: preview rollout config:
flags:
  name: fastfail_v2
  scope: [global, region, tenant]
steps:
  - percent: 1
    scope: global
    duration: 2h
  - percent: 10
    scope: region
    duration: 12h
  - tenant_opt_in: true
fallbacks:
  - model_variant: quant-4
    trigger: p95_latency > 800ms OR queue_depth > 200

Tara (RESEARCH): Add eval hooks: sample prompts from top customers, run regression checks tied to alerts. If quality delta > threshold, auto-stop rollout.
Sam (PM): Action items: Jordana implement flag API + routing policy (ETA 10d). Kevin run threshold sims + propose alarms + kill-switch UX (ETA 4d). Tara produce AB sample plan and eval set (ETA 3d). I'll confirm opt-in timeline with Fern. :thumbsup:
